q07. web/src/connect.ts

The ConnectRPC service clients are created in **web/src/connect.ts** using the `createClient` function from `@connectrpc/connect`. Lines 192-203 show the creation of all service clients (instanceServiceClient, authServiceClient, userServiceClient, memoServiceClient, attachmentServiceClient, aiServiceClient, shortcutServiceClient, and identityProviderServiceClient), all using the same transport that includes authentication interceptor setup.
